metadata.description: Sten Capital's internal Claude plugins for the ayunit / Agnes backoffice — one plugin per Portfolio/Global domain.

plugins.name: account-transaction
plugins.description: Portfolio.AccountTransaction tools on the ayunit MCP. Loader: ubs-miami. Orchestrator: transaction-workday-audit (Check 1 → routines:new-asset-onboarding; Check 2 chains compromissada-fix → assetrelated-fix → pending-revalidate → pending-position-repair → duplicate-trade-reconcile → position-quantity-adjustment). Fixers: pending-revalidate, pending-position-repair, duplicate-trade-reconcile, assetrelated-fix, compromissada-fix, position-quantity-adjustment. Every write goes through a sibling's own preview/confirm/execute + CheckedDate lock enforcement.

plugins.name: position
plugins.description: Position monitoring & reconciliation for Portfolio.v_AccountPosition (book of record) against v_CustodyPosition (broker snapshot). Includes inception-position for seeding the first day of a newly-onboarded account. (Custody↔asset mapping in v_AssetCustody moved to the asset plugin.)

plugins.name: asset
plugins.description: Security-master tools for Global.Asset and Portfolio.AssetCustody on the ayunit MCP. Skills: asset-lookup (read-only pre-check that resolves any custody-side identifier — ISIN/CUSIP/CNPJ/ANBIMA/numeric custody code/free-text — to a canonical Asset, mandatory before any registration attempt); asset-register (registration-by-analogy for a NEW instrument, validates every classification against its lookup, runs duplicate+identifier gate, previews, and INSERTs via Global.Asset_Update); register-br-funds (BR-fund cadastro path when only the CNPJ is known: CNPJ → ANBIMA classe/subclasse → get_anbima_cadastral_data → hand-off to asset-register); register-debenture (BR-debenture path from an Anbima code/ISIN: get_debenture_register_data → remuneration parsing → Global.Asset mapping → hand-off to asset-register for NEW rows, or field-by-field audit + gap-fill U completing missing columns on already-registered ones); assetcustody-fill (durable upstream fix: INSERTs the missing per-custody AssetCustody mapping ONCE, then back-fills Portfolio.CustodyPosition in bulk via Update_Missing_Asset, then unblocks PENDING transactions per-mapping instead of per-pk); asset-price-history (backfills AssetData.Price via the fixed source-priority chain v_Price → AssetDataDB.v_MarketData → AssetDataDB.v_Price → v_CustodyPosition×PriceFactor, never overwriting existing rows silently).

plugins.name: routines
plugins.description: Orchestrator skills (meta-skills) that chain leaf skills from account-transaction, asset, and position into daily/weekly backoffice routines and one-shot onboarding pipelines. Designed for Claude Cowork Desktop scheduled tasks (daily ones) or manual invocation (one-shots). Skills: new-asset-onboarding (daily master-data sweep across all custodies), daily-btg-onshore-routine (BTG onshore reconciliation), daily-btg-offshore-routine (BTG Cayman reconciliation), btg-onshore-onboarding (one-shot inception-position backlog pipeline that seeds Portfolio.AccountPosition + advances the first CheckedDate for BTG onshore accounts with custody rows but no lock yet — runs before the daily routines take over).

plugins.name: anbima-data
plugins.description: ANBIMA skills for Brazilian investment funds — thin routing layer over the Ayunit MCP (no bundled Python, no credentials). Data skills: anbima-funds-data (cadastral registry), anbima-funds-historical-data (NAV/PL/cota series). Live-artifact skill: anbima-funds-explorer (interactive HTML dashboard, Cowork-optimised). Cross-surface: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Claude Cowork.

plugins.name: marketplace-tools
plugins.description: Meta-plugin for interactive review of candidate contributions to this marketplace. Skills: skill-review (audits a candidate SKILL.md against a target plugin and live-verifies Ayunit MCP references + docs); artifact-review (audits a candidate live-artifact HTML for MCP-tool existence, Cowork bridge usage, sibling consistency, and security hygiene). Emits VERDICT reports (ACCEPT_NEW / MERGE_INTO_SIBLING / REJECT). Ayunit-MCP-only; no credentials, no bundled code.
